project_type: Go backend service — REST API + background worker + DocuSign integration
build_system: Go modules (go mod). No Makefile yet — use `go build`, `go test`, `go mod tidy` directly. Module name: github.com/your-org/docusign-master-service
test_framework: stdlib testing package. Run with: go test ./... (or per-package: go test ./internal/security/...)
verification_instructions: 1. go mod tidy (resolve deps). 2. go build ./... (all packages compile). 3. go test ./... (all tests pass). 4. docker build -t docusign-ms . (image builds).
snapshot_or_generated_files: go.sum is generated by go mod tidy — must be committed. No other generated files.
environment_constraints: Workspace root is /home/simon/Downloads/DocuSign Master Service (note the space in path — always quote it). Go 1.26.8 is installed at /usr/local/go. No live DocuSign credentials available — all tests use mock HTTP servers.
contribution_requirements: All tests must use mock servers, no live credentials. Never log tokens/keys/secrets. Use stdlib log/slog for logging. Use dependency injection (no package-level singletons). Every HTTP handler must delegate all business logic to a service layer.
key_patterns:
Greenfield project — no existing patterns to follow. Architecture: cmd/server/main.go wires everything together via dependency injection. internal/* packages are not importable externally. Chi router for HTTP. pgx/v5 for PostgreSQL (positional $N placeholders). parquet-go struct tags: `parquet:"name"`. HMAC canonical string: METHOD
PATH
TIMESTAMP
NONCE
SHA256(BODY). Job status constants: PENDING, FETCHING_ENVELOPES, FETCHING_DETAILS, NORMALIZING, UPLOADING_TO_MINIO, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED, CRASHED.
directory_structure: docusign-master-service/ (workspace root) — cmd/server/main.go (entry point), internal/ (all business logic packages: config, database, security, resilience, audit, docusign, normalization, storage, jobs, httpapi), migrations/ (SQL files), tests/ (integration tests), scripts/ (signing example), Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, .env.example, go.mod, README.md, DESIGN.md
tricky_notes: parquet-go/parquet-go is pre-v1; use struct tags `parquet:"name"` for schema; *string and *time.Time for nullable fields
pgx/v5: use positional $1/$2 placeholders throughout (not @name syntax)
DocuSign JWT aud claim must be hostname only (e.g. account-d.docusign.com), not a URL
MinIO: call BucketExists before MakeBucket to avoid BucketAlreadyOwnedByYou error
Chi: use chi.URLParam(r, "scan_id") for path params
NoncStore: pass context.Context to constructor to stop background cleanup goroutine in tests
